briefs.brief_cn: TJX 的消费主题卡点不是传统供应短缺，而是“低价品牌货源获取 + 买手执行 + 门店周转”的运营卡点。最新一季公司披露 FY2027 Q1 可比销售增长 6%，所有分部可比销售均增长，毛利率同比提升至 31.3%，库存同比增加并称优质品牌货源供应充足。这支持其在消费者追求性价比、品牌商去库存和线下寻宝式消费中的优势。需要警惕的是：如果货源质量下降、库存增长变成滞销、关税/燃油/盗损压缩毛利，或可比销售回落，则该卡点逻辑应降级。
briefs.brief_en: TJX’s consumer chokepoint is not a formal supply shortage; it is access to branded closeout inventory, merchant execution, and fast store-level inventory turns. In Q1 FY2027, TJX reported 6% consolidated comp-sales growth, broad divisional comp growth, gross margin improvement to 31.3%, and higher inventories supported by what management described as strong branded merchandise availability. This supports the thesis that TJX benefits from value-seeking consumers and fragmented off-price sourcing. The thesis weakens if inventory growth becomes stale inventory, merchandise quality falls, tariffs/fuel/shrink pressure gross margin, or comps decelerate materially.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: TJX controls a high-purity off-price retail node where scale, vendor relationships, and merchant execution convert fragmented branded inventory availability into consumer value traffic.
evidence_to_verify: FY2027 Q1 comp sales +6%, net sales $14.3B, and raised FY2027 comp/margin/EPS guidance in TJX release: https://investor.tjx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/tjx-reports-q1-fy27-results-comp-sales-6-pretax-profit-margin

Gross profit margin 31.3%, up 1.8 percentage points year over year, driven partly by merchandise margin and expense leverage: https://investor.tjx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/tjx-reports-q1-fy27-results-comp-sales-6-pretax-profit-margin

Inventories were $7.7B versus $7.1B one year earlier; per-store inventory up 7% reported / 6% constant currency: https://investor.tjx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/tjx-reports-q1-fy27-results-comp-sales-6-pretax-profit-margin
falsification: Comparable sales fall toward flat or negative while inventory per store remains elevated.
Gross margin or merchandise margin declines despite continued sales growth, suggesting pricing/tariff/shrink pressure is being absorbed.
Management commentary shifts from strong branded-goods availability to constrained or lower-quality inventory.
Traffic growth weakens and sales growth becomes primarily price-led.
monitoring_items: Quarterly comparable sales by division and customer-transaction commentary
Gross margin, merchandise margin, shrink and markdown commentary
Inventory per store, inventory in transit, and seasonal freshness
Tariff, freight, fuel and FX impact on margin guidance
Store growth and square-foot productivity

briefs.brief_cn: Mastercard 的卡点在全球支付网络、清算/授权基础设施和增值服务数据层。公司 FY2026 Q1 披露净收入增长 16%，本地货币口径总交易金额增长 7%、购买量增长 9%、跨境量增长 13%、交换交易增长 9%，增值服务和解决方案收入增长 22%。这说明其受益于消费电子化、跨境旅行和商户/银行对风控、认证、数据服务的需求。主要反证是监管压低 interchange/网络经济性、账户到账户支付或稳定币绕开网络、跨境消费放缓、返利激励侵蚀收入质量。
briefs.brief_en: Mastercard’s chokepoint is the global card-network rail plus its authentication, data, security, and value-added services layer. In Q1 2026, Mastercard reported 16% net revenue growth, 7% gross dollar volume growth, 9% purchase volume growth, 13% cross-border volume growth, 9% switched-transaction growth, and 22% value-added services and solutions growth. This supports exposure to digital commerce, travel normalization, and rising demand for fraud, authentication, and data services. The thesis weakens if regulation compresses network economics, account-to-account or stablecoin rails bypass cards, cross-border slows, or incentives dilute revenue quality.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: Mastercard is a scaled consumer-payment infrastructure node where acceptance breadth, issuer/acquirer integration, cross-border rails, and value-added services create durable transaction leverage.
evidence_to_verify: Q1 2026 net revenue $8.4B, up 16% reported / 12% currency-neutral: https://s25.q4cdn.com/479285134/files/doc_financials/2026/q1/1Q26-Mastercard-Earnings-Release.pdf

Q1 2026 gross dollar volume up 7%, purchase volume up 9%, cross-border volume up 13%, switched transactions up 9%: https://s25.q4cdn.com/479285134/files/doc_financials/2026/q1/1Q26-Mastercard-Earnings-Release.pdf
Value-added services and solutions net revenue up 22% reported / 18% currency-neutral: https://s25.q4cdn.com/479285134/files/doc_financials/2026/q1/1Q26-Mastercard-Earnings-Release.pdf

Mastercard listed regulatory, interchange, surcharging, privacy/data/AI and disintermediation risks in its Q1 2026 release: https://s25.q4cdn.com/479285134/files/doc_financials/2026/q1/1Q26-Mastercard-Earnings-Release.pdf
falsification: Switched-transaction growth and purchase-volume growth decelerate below nominal consumption growth.
Cross-border volume growth normalizes sharply or turns negative.
Rebates and incentives grow faster than network revenue for multiple quarters.
Regulatory action materially reduces interchange, network fees, routing economics or data monetization.
Alternative payment rails gain share without Mastercard capturing economics through partnerships or services.
monitoring_items: Gross dollar volume, purchase volume, cross-border volume and switched transactions
Value-added services growth and mix
Rebates/incentives as a percentage of network revenue
Regulatory developments on interchange, routing, surcharging, open banking and data rules
Stablecoin, account-to-account and agentic commerce product traction

briefs.brief_cn: MercadoLibre 是本批次中更复合的消费者基础设施候选：电商市场、支付、信贷、物流和广告互相强化。公司 Q1 2026 披露已提交 10-Q 和股东信，第三方转述显示收入/金融收入约 88.45 亿美元、同比增长 49%；市场摘要显示 GMV、支付、信贷和物流投资继续扩张，但利润率承压。卡点在拉美市场中商户获客、履约密度、支付接受度、数据风控和广告流量。主要风险是信贷扩张质量、巴西/墨西哥竞争、低免邮门槛导致的补贴化增长、汇率和国家宏观波动。
briefs.brief_en: MercadoLibre is the most multi-node consumer infrastructure candidate in this chunk: marketplace, payments, credit, logistics, and ads reinforce each other. The company’s Q1 2026 filings and shareholder-letter links are posted on its IR site; secondary summaries report roughly $8.845B of net revenue and financial income, up 49% year over year, with continued GMV/fintech/logistics expansion but margin pressure from investment. The chokepoint is Latin American merchant access, fulfillment density, payments acceptance, data-driven credit, and ad monetization. The thesis weakens if growth is subsidy-led, credit losses rise, Brazil/Mexico competition intensifies, or FX/macro shocks overwhelm operating leverage.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: MercadoLibre may be a regional consumer-infrastructure chokepoint because its marketplace, Mercado Pago, logistics network, credit rails, and ad data increase merchant and consumer switching costs across Latin America.
evidence_to_verify: MercadoLibre IR page lists Q1 2026 shareholder letter, earnings presentation, webcast transcript, and SEC filing; Q1 2026 10-Q filed May 8, 2026: https://investor.mercadolibre.com/sec-filings
SEC Q1 2026 10-Q filing page for quarter ended March 31, 2026: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1099590/000109959026000017/meli-20260331.htm

BusinessWire release says Q1 2026 results were reported through a Letter to Shareholders on the company IR site: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260507262226/en/MercadoLibre-Inc.-Reports-First-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results

Nasdaq-hosted company press release mirrors the Q1 2026 results announcement and points to MercadoLibre IR: https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/mercadolibre-inc-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results-2026-05-07
falsification: GMV and item growth remain strong only where shipping subsidies or take-rate cuts intensify.
Credit portfolio growth outpaces underwriting capability and delinquency/loss metrics deteriorate.
Logistics penetration rises but unit economics fail to improve.
Advertising revenue or take rate stalls despite higher marketplace scale.
Country-level FX, inflation, tax, or regulatory shocks materially impair reported growth or cash generation.
monitoring_items: GMV, items sold, unique buyers and country-level growth, especially Brazil, Mexico and Argentina
Total payment volume, Mercado Pago active users, off-platform TPV and acquiring penetration
Credit portfolio size, NPLs, provisions, charge-offs and funding costs
Logistics penetration, same-day/next-day delivery coverage and cost per shipment
Advertising revenue, take rate, operating margin and free cash flow

briefs.brief_cn: FICO 的消费卡点来自信用评分标准、贷款机构工作流嵌入和监管/合规认可，而不是消费总量本身。公司 FY2026 Q2 披露 Scores 收入约 4.75 亿美元，去年同期约 2.97 亿美元；总收入约 6.92 亿美元，稀释 EPS 11.14 美元。公司还称 FICO Score 被美国前 90% 贷款机构使用。这支持其在按揭、汽车、信用卡等消费信贷承销中的基础设施地位。关键反证是监管推动低价或替代评分、FHFA/抵押贷款评分体系变化、客户绕开或压价、增长主要来自一次性提价而非长期使用量和标准地位。
briefs.brief_en: FICO’s consumer chokepoint is credit-risk standardization, lender workflow embedding, and regulatory/market acceptance rather than headline consumption. In Q2 FY2026, FICO reported Scores revenue of about $475M versus about $297M a year earlier, total revenue of about $692M, and diluted EPS of $11.14. The company states that the FICO Score is used by 90% of top U.S. lenders. This supports its role in mortgage, auto, card, and consumer-credit underwriting. The thesis weakens if regulators force cheaper or alternative scores, mortgage score-choice changes reduce pricing power, lenders bypass FICO, or revenue growth proves mostly one-time price uplift.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: FICO is a consumer-credit infrastructure chokepoint if lenders, investors, regulators, and workflows continue to rely on FICO scores as a standardized credit-risk language.
evidence_to_verify: FICO Q2 FY2026 total revenue was $691.7M and diluted EPS was $11.14: https://fico.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/fico-announces-earnings-1114-share-second-quarter-fiscal-2026
Scores revenue was $474.973M in Q2 FY2026 versus $297.039M in Q2 FY2025: https://fico.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/fico-announces-earnings-1114-share-second-quarter-fiscal-2026

FICO states its score is used by 90% of top U.S. lenders and is available in over 40 countries: https://fico.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/fico-announces-earnings-1114-share-second-quarter-fiscal-2026

FICO highlights risks including macro conditions, competition, regulatory changes affecting consumer credit/data use or cost, and customer/distributor relationships: https://fico.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/fico-announces-earnings-1114-share-second-quarter-fiscal-2026
falsification: Scores revenue growth decelerates after pricing changes or mortgage volumes normalize.
Major lenders, GSEs, or regulators adopt alternative scores at scale and reduce FICO dependence.
Regulatory action limits score pricing, data usage, or required score availability.
Customer concentration or distributor renegotiation reduces realized price per score.
Consumer-credit volumes weaken enough to offset pricing power.
monitoring_items: Scores revenue split by B2B, B2C, mortgage and non-mortgage use cases
Volume-led versus price-led growth disclosures
Mortgage origination volumes and FICO Score 10T adoption
Regulatory actions from FHFA, CFPB and other credit-data authorities
Alternative-data and competing-score adoption by major lenders

claims_supported: FY2027 Q1 gross profit margin was 31.3%.
Inventory was $7.7B and per-store inventory rose year over year.
Management raised FY2027 comp-sales, margin and EPS guidance.
Gross dollar volume rose 7%, purchase volume rose 9%, cross-border volume rose 13%, and switched transactions rose 9%.
Value-added services and solutions revenue increased 22%.
Regulatory and disintermediation risks are disclosed by the company.
MercadoLibre posted Q1 2026 shareholder letter, earnings presentation, webcast transcript and SEC filing links.
MercadoLibre filed Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
MercadoLibre reported Q1 2026 financial results through a Letter to Shareholders on its investor relations site.
FICO states its score is used by 90% of top U.S. lenders.

memory_update.update: Prioritize monitoring comp-sales durability, inventory quality, gross margin, shrink and tariff/fuel effects. Current company evidence supports off-price execution strength but not a structural supply scarcity in the formal sense.
Payment-network thesis remains evidence-rich and highly falsifiable through GDV, purchase volume, cross-border volume, switched transactions, value-added services growth and rebate intensity.

MELI should remain a high-quality multi-node consumer infrastructure candidate, but next pass needs direct extraction from Q1 2026 shareholder letter/10-Q for GMV, TPV, credit quality, logistics penetration, ads revenue and margin bridge.

FICO has the clearest supplier-scarcity/chokepoint profile in consumer credit, but thesis sensitivity is high to regulation, mortgage score-choice changes, alternative-score adoption and price-versus-volume growth mix.

summary: Layer 4 briefs for ranked candidate chunk covering off-price retail, card-network rails, Latin American commerce/fintech infrastructure, and consumer-credit scoring. These are research briefs only, not trading recommendations. Current primary-source evidence supports ongoing demand/rail usage strength, while the main unresolved questions are margin durability, credit/regulatory risk, and whether recent growth is repeatable rather than one-quarter driven.
